population: R|t ~ Binomial(5,t); fixed symmetric family grid, equal item weights
selection: exhaustive validation minimization (negative correlation); same nine candidates, no extra searches
ties: absolute tolerance 1e-12, relative tolerance zero; enumerate every minimizer; uniform-tie mean and min/max metrics, no favorable ordering
undefined_correlation: undefined constant-input candidates ineligible for that criterion; all-undefined selection is a retained failure
uncertainty: 95% Student t Monte Carlo confidence interval for repeat-average over independent rating replications; 2.5/97.5 percentiles and SD report repeat variability separately; deterministic population values have no sampling CI
